title: Terms & Conditions
subtitle: Readable, summarized terms so you can quickly understand your rights and responsibilities.

quickSummary.title: Quick summary
quickSummary.item1: Be honest and accurate when posting property listings.
quickSummary.item2: Verify buyers/sellers and meet safely — we don't mediate transactions.
quickSummary.item3: We may remove content that breaks our rules or local laws.

usingSite.title: 1. Using the site
usingSite.text: You may browse listings for free. Creating an account and posting listings requires accurate contact and property information. Keep your password secure and enable any available account protections.

postingListings.title: 2. Posting listings
postingListings.text: When posting a listing, provide truthful descriptions, correct pricing, and clear photos. Listings with misleading or fraudulent information may be removed. Add contact details and availability to help buyers reach you faster.

safetyTips.title: 3. Safety tips
safetyTips.card1Desc: Meet in public places and bring someone with you for viewings.
safetyTips.card2Desc: Use verified payment methods and get written receipts.
safetyTips.card3Desc: Verify the identity of people you transact with before sharing personal information.
safetyTips.card4Desc: Report suspicious listings or users so we can take action quickly.

liability.title: 4. Limitation of liability
liability.text: The platform is a listing service and provided "as is." We do not guarantee the accuracy of user-submitted content and are not responsible for disputes or losses arising from interactions between users.

disputes.title: 5. Disputes and termination
disputes.text: We reserve the right to suspend or remove accounts or listings that violate these terms. For disputes between users, please seek direct resolution or legal advice where necessary.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.text: For questions about these terms, reach out to our support team. Include relevant listing IDs or account details to help us respond quickly.
